title: Multi-chart mode
content:
You can enable the multi-chart mode by clicking on the "Select Layout" button at the top of your chart. You can select up to 8 charts.
You can maximize the chart you need by clicking the 'Maximize chart' button or by pressing Alt+Enter or Alt+Click on the chart.
To switch between charts in a multi-chart layout, just press Tab .
